rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `nova/equilibrium/steering_frames.py` hides the whole session layout, the frame assembly and the store behind one typed record plus a write/read pair, and states explicitly that a frame is assembled-not-computed across four carriers; `apps/playable/session.py` hides the solve loop behind a solve-callable protocol so the production and reduced routes swap without the app changing. One record behind several consumers, not several shallow wrappers over the same machinery.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §6 deliverable A adds `scripts/playable_server/run.sh` as a fresh submit-to-betelgeuse launcher while `scripts/nova_lane/run.sh` already owns placement (rung ladder, `rung_sbatch_flags`, `--dry-run`/`--in-place`/`--force-submit`), and the plan cites neither it nor `scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh` (zero mentions of either). The path-resolution duplicate (`apps/playable/main.py:280`) and the labeller-writer duplicate are already recorded and are confirmed below.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — supplied counts are public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §7 adds three CLI options and a public protocol and §8 adds two public modules and an option, and neither section's text names what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design sections name the existing mechanisms they extend, and each was confirmed in code: the constraint vocabulary is `nova/equilibrium/inverse.py` (`Control.update_constraints`, lines 186–202) over `nova/geometry/plasmapoints.py` `ControlPoints` (§2); the reduced route is `nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py` (§3); the poloidal renderer is `apps/pulsedesign/poloidal_view.py`, imported at `apps/playable/main.py:61` (§4); the session store is a netCDF/xarray group, the store nova already owns (§5).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one wrapper the plan adds, the `FrameDecoder` protocol in `apps/playable/camera.py`, is justified in §7 by the coupled-repository rule (nova must never import imas-ambix), which is a reason the underlying decoder cannot be extended in place. The justification is present in the section text.
